summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim results announcement for the six months ended June 30, 2026, as published on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong. The filing is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer, containing no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. It does not disclose any transaction terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. The filing merely satisfies SEC reporting obligations for the month of August 2026. As a routine earnings disclosure, it does not qualify as a special situation and is classified as None.
